messages:
maria-sre: FYI scheduling an internal failover rehearsal for next Tue 2026-04-07 01:00-02:00 UTC. Purpose: validate cross-region routing policies + warm-pool failover for hosted API. No public outage expected, but we'll temporarily change routing weights and simulate a region blackout.

jon-ops: Sounds good. What's the exact plan for traffic shift?

maria-sre: Plan: 1) canary switch 5% of traffic away from us-east1 to eu-west1 for 10m; 2) simulate us-east1 full blackout for 15m by withdrawing endpoints; 3) observe failover to warm pools and dedicated fallbacks. We'll run from control plane with gradual steps and holdpoints.

kevin-platform: Adding additional constraints: Dedicated pools with SLO_override = true MUST be left untouched unless CS signs off. We'll annotate those pools in the runbook. Also I'll flip the feature-flag routing.playbook.simulate_failover = true only for the rehearsal workspace.

ellie-eng: We'll enable throttled retry backoff in the client gate for the window to avoid cascading retries. Also will push a non-disruptive config to our SDKs so tests hit the fallback flow.

carla-cs: Can we get a one-pager for support + CS? I want bullet points we can paste to customers if anyone asks.

maria-sre: Yes. Short blurb: "We will run an internal failover rehearsal on 2026-04-07 01:00-02:00 UTC. No expected disruption. Purpose: verify routing and warm-pool failover. Dedicated pools with SLA=true are exempt by default. Contact support if you have strict blackout windows." I'll drop that in #customer-success.

maria-sre: Runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/failover-rehearsal-2026. Key metrics to watch: p50/p90/p99 request latency, http 5xx rate, token throughput, warm-pool attach rate. Rollback if p99 > 750ms sustained 5m OR 5xx rate > 1% absolute.

jon-ops: I'll create a tiny k6 script for the validation load and share it here. Will also label the canary traffic with header X-Rehearsal: true.

jon-ops: ```
# basic k6 snippet
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({input:'rehearsal'}), {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer $KEY','X-Rehearsal':'true'}});
  sleep(0.5);
}
```

kevin-platform: I'll coordinate with networking to ensure cross-region peering has spare capacity. Also toggling autoscaler min replicas to avoid scale-to-zero during the run.

ellie-eng: Product note: enabling tiny-model fallback for sessions older than 2m during the window so long-running streams don't stall. Will add a toggle in prod flags.

carla-cs: Thanks. I'll prepare a canned reply and update the customer status template.

status-bot: scheduled: internal.failover-rehearsal starts 2026-04-07T01:00:00Z. Reminder 24h and 1h prior.

maria-sre: Security note: we'll not simulate any data-plane changes, only routing. No key or customer data will be moved. If you have objections, raise them within 48h.

jon-ops: Acked. I'll be primary operator for the rehearsal, with kevin-platform as backup.

maria-sre: TL;DR: internal failover rehearsal 2026-04-07 01:00-02:00 UTC; canary then simulated blackout; Dedicated SLA=true pools exempt; rollback thresholds p99>750ms >5m or 5xx>1%. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have ownership for a task.
